events.known_information: IPO priced at $19; offering/capital structure and loss-making history disclosed.
events.note: Do not use later 2025 actual revenue as an IPO-date forecast.

events.event: IPO completion / first clear post-completion market close in IBKR history
events.known_information: 19.167M IPO shares issued; preferred and convertible notes converted; debt repayment scheduled/completed in August.
events.market_expectation: Public price quickly traded well above the $19 offer price.
events.note: The listing was already undergoing public-market repricing.

events.known_information: Q3 revenue $46.3M +41%; FFRCT 98% of revenue; revenue-case definition disclosed; cash $291.2M and funded debt extinguished.
events.market_expectation: Growth was no longer an undiscovered narrative; key question shifted to durability and product expansion.
events.note: Revenue case is not unique patient/procedure volume.

events.known_information: FY2025 revenue $176.0M +40%; FFRCT 98% of revenue; Plaque remained early; company remained loss-making.
events.market_expectation: Scaled FFRCT franchise already publicly visible.
events.note: Future rerating increasingly depended on Plaque, CCTA growth and operating leverage.

events.known_information: Revenue $52.6M +41%, GAAP GM 80.2%, FY2026 guide raised to $228-232M.
events.market_expectation: Strong expectations were already embedded enough that the next-session close fell despite the beat/raise.

events.known_information: Revenue $64.1M +48%; cases 84,491 +74%; GAAP GM ~83%; Plaque $7.8M management commentary; FY revenue guide $246-250M; Plaque guide $29-31M.
events.market_expectation: Consensus was materially surprised, but the price had not yet incorporated the after-hours evidence into a completed-session close.
events.note: Fundamental acceleration was genuine; lifecycle still required reclassification at the next price.

events.known_information: All Q2 evidence plus new market price; stock +35.7% in one day; reconstructed EV ~15.3x FY2026 sales.
events.market_expectation: A meaningful portion of the new Plaque/platform probability was rapidly capitalized into price.
events.note: This is the canonical false-stage node: P0 research priority remained correct, strict New Ignition did not.

events.known_information: Deep case includes diluted EV, metric ontology, reverse-return math, competition/legal risk and current trigger framework.
events.market_expectation: High consensus and elevated price-implied expectations relative to the IPO/discovery phase.
events.note: Uses 2026-08-17 completed close for reproducible current valuation; Aug 18 was intraday.
